email.body1:
Kyle, saw Placer.ai cross $100M ARR and expand into new lines like government and PinPoint data.

Growth at that pace usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Placer.ai off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kyle, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

As new segments open, the pipeline target moves faster than headcount and enablement can keep up. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Placer.ai needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kyle, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Placer.ai's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling data platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
